llm.summary: The skill is largely coherent for a YouTube-scoring integration (requires only an API key and uses curl/jq), but the API base URL (a convex.site subdomain) does not obviously match the advertised homepage (worthclip.com) and the source is unknown — verify the endpoint and inspect the shipped scripts before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, required binaries (curl, jq), and required env var (WORTHCLIP_API_KEY) align with a service that calls an external API to score YouTube videos. However, the documented API Base URL (https://greedy-mallard-11.convex.site/api/v1) is on a convex.site subdomain rather than an obvious worthclip.com API host; this mismatch is worth verifying with the vendor.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run bundled shell scripts to call the external API, poll job status, fetch feeds, and check usage — actions that stay within the declared purpose. The instructions do send video IDs and other request data to the external API (expected), and they do not request unrelated local files or additional environment variables in the text. Still, the skill includes executable scripts that will run network calls, so those script files should be reviewed before use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) and included scripts mean nothing is downloaded or extracted at install time — low install risk. The skill will execute bundled shell scripts at runtime; no external install URLs or archive extracts are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API key (WORTHCLIP_API_KEY) is required and declared as the primary credential, which is proportionate for a third-party API integration. Confirm that the key will be sent only to the legitimate WorthClip endpoints (see note about base URL).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not set always:true and has disable-model-invocation:true, so the model cannot autonomously invoke it and it isn't forced into every run — this limits privilege and persistence appropriately for a credentialed API client.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing: (1) Review the three bundled scripts (scripts/score.sh, scripts/feed.sh, scripts/usage.sh) line-by-line to confirm they only call the declared API and don't read or exfiltrate local files or other env vars. (2) Verify the API base URL is legitimate for WorthClip — contact WorthClip support or check DNS/SSL ownership for greedy-mallard-11.convex.site to ensure it is an official endpoint. (3) Only provide a dedicated API key scoped to this integration (do not reuse high-privilege or long-lived keys), and be prepared to rotate it if anything looks suspicious. (4) Consider running the scripts in a restricted environment (network-limited or ephemeral container) the first time to observe behavior. If you cannot confirm the convex.site endpoint is official, treat the skill as untrusted and do not supply your API key.
